import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 参数 ===
bearing_od = 22    # 轴承外径 (mm) - 608轴承
bearing_w = 7      # 轴承宽度 (mm)
wall = 6           # 壁厚 (mm)
base_h = 12        # 底座高度 (mm)
bolt_d = 5         # 安装孔直径 (mm)
bolt_spacing = 50  # 安装孔间距 (mm)

# === 计算 ===
total_w = bearing_od + 2 * wall
total_h = bearing_od / 2 + wall + base_h
total_l = bearing_w + 2 * wall

# === 建模 ===
# 底座
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(bolt_spacing + 20, total_l, base_h)
)

# 圆柱支撑
pillar = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .circle(total_w / 2)
    .extrude(total_l)
    .translate((0, -total_l / 2, base_h))
)
result = result.union(pillar)

# 轴承孔
result = (
    result
    .faces(">Y").workplane()
    .hole(bearing_od)
)

# 安装孔
result = (
    result
    .faces("<Z").workplane()
    .rect(bolt_spacing, 0, forConstruction=True)
    .vertices()
    .hole(bolt_d)
)

show_object(result)
